diagnosis: The Express application mounts a tenant sub-application on '/tenants/:tenantId/invoices', but the child route handler queries invoices by req.params.invoiceId without asserting that the invoice belongs to req.params.tenantId or checking whether req.params.tenantId matches req.user.tenantId. An attacker belonging to tenant A can request '/tenants/tenant_a/invoices/inv_tenant_b_9918' to access tenant B's proprietary billing invoices.
exploit_request:
GET /tenants/tenant_alpha_inc/invoices/inv_beta_corp_88301 HTTP/1.1
Host: billing.platform.internal:8080
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_alpha_token>
Accept: application/json
